method: curl + PageSpeed Insights API + HTML analysis + web_fetch
anti_duplicate_note: Focus on aspects NOT covered by Apr-30 23:45 or May-01 00:45 tests: PageSpeed mobile performance metrics, product detail page responsive images (srcset/picture), mobile form analysis, tap-target/accessibility via PSI, English/ES category page comparison, mobile page weight breakdown, catalog mode (is_catalog=true) implications
scenario: Mobile Performance & Product Page Responsive Analysis

tools_used: PageSpeed Insights API × 3 (home ES, home EN, product ES)
Python HTML analysis (srcset, picture, form, layout analysis)

landing_es.verdict: LCP is critical (5.7s). Needs image optimization and JS reduction.

landing_en.verdict: Better performance than ES. CLS borderline (0.139). Accessibility audit had parse issues.

product_es.verdict: TTI very high (8.7s) due to JS execution. 93 requests, 1398KB total. Good CLS.

product_detail_page.verdict: PASS - Product pages have excellent responsive images (WebP + JPG, srcset, sizes, picture elements)

homepage_es.verdict: WARN - Homepage listing images lack srcset

category_page_en.verdict: WARN - Category listing images (25) lack srcset despite lazy loading

search_results.verdict: WARN - Search results images lack srcset

add_to_cart_button.note: CTA 'btn btn-primary' present in product page

catalog_mode.implication: Marketplace model: prices shown as 'A consultar' (ask seller), contact seller via module

worst_offenders.note: Red price text - insufficient contrast against background
Badge white text on light tint
Category count text extremely low contrast

missing_link_names.note: Probably icon-only buttons (browse categories, sell product) without accessible labels

unused_javascript.note: Unused JS indicates bundle optimization opportunity

cart_es_desktop.note: Same HTML as mobile, CSS handles layout

warnings.description: ES Home LCP is 5.7s on mobile (red: <2.5s needed)
warnings.impact: Users on 3G/4G see blank screen for ~6 seconds before main content renders
warnings.recommendation: Optimize hero images, implement critical CSS, defer non-critical JS, use image CDN

warnings.description: Product page TTI is 8.7s on mobile (heavy JS: 39 scripts = 621KB + 22 third-party = 495KB)
warnings.impact: Unusable for ~9 seconds on slow connections
warnings.recommendation: Code-split JS bundles, lazy-load non-critical third-party scripts, implement resource hints (preload/preconnect)

warnings.description: EN Home CLS is 0.139 (threshold: 0.1 for PASS)
warnings.impact: Layout shift causes accidental taps on mobile
warnings.recommendation: Set explicit dimensions on dynamically loaded content and images

warnings.description: 49 color contrast issues on homepage (price text #e94560 has 3.82:1 ratio, placeholder #adb5bd has 1.96:1)
warnings.impact: WCAG AA failure for normal text (<4.5:1). Users with low vision cannot read prices, categories, or badge text
warnings.recommendation: Increase price contrast (min 4.5:1), increase placeholder/badge contrast. Darken #e94560 to ~#c33 or add dark background

warnings.description: 2 navigation links lack discernible name ('Sell' and category browse buttons)
warnings.impact: Screen reader users cannot identify these navigation actions
warnings.recommendation: Add aria-label or visually hidden span to icon-only buttons

warnings.description: Category and search listing pages (25+ images) have NO srcset/sizes despite loading='lazy'
warnings.impact: Mobile users download 400-720px images on 390px screens - wasted bandwidth on listing-heavy pages
warnings.recommendation: Add srcset with existing image variants (98x98 through 400x400) to category/product listing thumbnails

warnings.description: Product page loads 39 scripts (621KB JS) + 22 third-party requests (495KB)
warnings.impact: 35.4% of total payload is third-party. 44.4% is JS. Mobile suffers severe CPU/network contention
warnings.recommendation: Audit third-party services, defer analytics/tracking/CDN scripts, implement resource prioritization

minor.description: 1 blank alt attribute on product page (out of 15 total images)
minor.note: Acceptable for decorative images but verify this is intentional

minor.description: Product URLs /es/product/NNN-name redirect (301) to friendly /es/tornos/NNN-name (0.24s redirect overhead)
minor.note: Redirect adds latency; consider fixing links to point directly to friendly URL

new_positive_findings.product_page_responsive_images: Product detail pages have EXCELLENT responsive image implementation: WebP + JPG fallback with 4 picture elements, srcset with width descriptors (400w, 720w), sizes at 360/768/992/1200px breakpoints. This was NOT covered by previous tests which only checked homepage/category pages.
new_positive_findings.alt_text: Product page has 14/15 images with meaningful alt text using product name
new_positive_findings.registration_form: Well-structured mobile form with 25 input fields, proper labels, required field markers, and password strength indicator
new_positive_findings.catalog_mode: Marketplace model works - prices shown as 'A consultar' with contact-seller modules present
new_positive_findings.lazy_loading: All category page images (25/25) use loading=lazy - good for mobile initial load

new_positive_findings_this_run: Product detail pages have proper responsive images (WebP + srcset + picture elements) - previous tests missed this
Registration form is well-structured for mobile (labels, required fields, password strength)
new_negative_findings_this_run: ES Home LCP is 5.7s on mobile - worst performance issue found
Product page TTI is 8.7s (39 scripts, 622KB JS, 495KB third-party)
49 color contrast accessibility issues on homepage
EN Home CLS at 0.139 exceeds threshold
Category/search listing pages (not product pages) lack srcset
recommendations: CRITICAL: Reduce LCP on mobile home page (5.7s) - optimize hero images, defer CSS/JS
HIGH: Fix 49 color contrast violations - price text, badges, placeholder text all below WCAG AA
HIGH: Add srcset to category/search listing thumbnails using PrestaShop's existing image variants
MEDIUM: Add aria-label to icon-only nav buttons (Sell, Browse Categories)
MEDIUM: Audit and defer 22 third-party requests (495KB on product page)
LOW: Fix stable CLS on EN homepage (0.139→<0.1)
LOW: Ensure product links point to friendly URLs instead of /product/NNN redirects
NEXT: Run Playwright visual comparison test (requires remote browser WS reconnect)
NEXT: Test actual mobile user flow buy/contact flow with real browser interaction
